title: 了 Step 2 · Something Changed! Sentence-了
description: 了 at the end announces a new situation: 下雨了 (it's started raining), 我饿了 (I'm hungry now), 他二十岁了, 我不去了 (I'm not going any more).

points.title: Sentence-了 = a new situation
points.summary: 了 at the end of the sentence says something is now different from before.
points.body:
- 下雨**了**！ It's (started) raining!
- 我饿**了**。 I'm hungry (now).
- 天黑**了**。 It's got dark.
- 他二十岁**了**。 He's twenty now.

Think of sentence-了 as a little **news flash** 📢.

**了 at a glance: done, or changed?**

| | where | means | example |
|---|---|---|---|
| verb-了 | right after the verb | **done** (completed action) | 我买**了**三本书。 |
| sentence-了 | end of the sentence | **changed** (new situation) | 下雨**了**。 我饿**了**。 |
| both | after the verb + at the end | **so far, and still going** | 我学**了**三年中文**了**。 |

**Where 了 does NOT go**
- With 没: 我**没**吃早饭 — never ~~没吃了~~.
- Habits and general states in the past: 我以前**常常**去, 他以前**是**老师, 我小时候**喜欢**画画.
- Plain description: 昨天很冷 — no 了 needed.

**Look-alikes:** 快 / 要 …了 = **about to** (快下雨了); 太…了 = **so / too** (太好了!) — no change involved.
examples: {下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{我们|wǒmen}{回家|huí jiā}{吧|ba}。
It's started raining — let's go home.

points.title: 不…了 = not any more
points.summary: 不 + verb + 了 = a change of plan or habit: no longer.
points.body:
- 我**不**去**了**。 I'm not going any more (I've changed my mind).
- 他**不**抽烟**了**。 He doesn't smoke any more.
- 我**不**想吃**了**。 I don't feel like eating any more.

**了 at a glance: done, or changed?**

| | where | means | example |
|---|---|---|---|
| verb-了 | right after the verb | **done** (completed action) | 我买**了**三本书。 |
| sentence-了 | end of the sentence | **changed** (new situation) | 下雨**了**。 我饿**了**。 |
| both | after the verb + at the end | **so far, and still going** | 我学**了**三年中文**了**。 |

**Where 了 does NOT go**
- With 没: 我**没**吃早饭 — never ~~没吃了~~.
- Habits and general states in the past: 我以前**常常**去, 他以前**是**老师, 我小时候**喜欢**画画.
- Plain description: 昨天很冷 — no 了 needed.

**Look-alikes:** 快 / 要 …了 = **about to** (快下雨了); 太…了 = **so / too** (太好了!) — no change involved.
examples: I'm too tired — I'm not going today after all.

questions.explanation: Sentence-**了** = a change: now it's raining.
notes: Sentence-了 is about **now**, a new situation.

questions.explanation: A new state: 饿**了** = I'm hungry now.
notes: 过 = experience — doesn't fit a feeling now.
着 = ongoing state of an action.
questions.translation: I didn't eat breakfast — now I'm hungry.

options: I'm not going any more (I've changed my mind).
questions.explanation: **不…了** = not any more — a change of plan.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{女儿|nǚ'ér}{今年|jīnnián}{六|liù}{岁|suì}（　），{可以|kěyǐ}{上|shàng}{小学|xiǎoxué}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: A new age = a new situation: 六岁**了**.
questions.translation: My daughter is six this year — she can start primary school.

questions.prompt: {医生|yīshēng}{说|shuō}{他|tā}{身体|shēntǐ}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}，{所以|suǒyǐ}{他|tā}{现在|xiànzài}（　）。
notes: Word order: 不 + verb + 了.
没…了 is wrong — 没 doesn't take 了.
questions.translation: The doctor said his health is bad, so he doesn't smoke any more.

questions.explanation: Sentence-了: **天黑了** = it's got dark (now).
notes: 太 needs 了 (太黑了) and means 'too', not a change.

questions.prompt:
A：{你|nǐ}{的|de}{中文|Zhōngwén}{怎么样|zěnmeyàng}？
B：{比|bǐ}{以前|yǐqián}{好|hǎo}{多|duō}（　）。
questions.explanation: Better than before = a change: 好多**了**.
questions.translation: A: How's your Chinese? B: Much better than before.

questions.prompt: 'I don't want to eat any more — I'm full.' Which sentence says so?
questions.explanation: 不…了 (not any more) + 饱了 (full now).
notes: 没 doesn't go with 了.
Without 了 it loses the 'any more' and 'now full'.
Word order and 着 are wrong.
questions.translation: I don't want to eat any more — I'm full.

questions.prompt: What does 「{他|tā}{是|shì}{大学生|dàxuéshēng}{了|le}。」 mean?
options: He's a university student now (he wasn't before).
He'll never be a university student.
notes: There's no question word or 吗.
